name: SUM-01 Thanks and bare no do not close
expected_outcome: Thanks alone does not close: the agent asks again whether the displayed details are correct. A bare no does not close either: the agent asks what the applicant would like to change. No closing message is sent. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.

name: SUM-02 Side question then correct confirms
expected_outcome: The start-date question gets one short answer that a licensed agent will follow up, then the confirmation question is repeated. Saved details are unchanged, and correct confirms the summary. After final confirmation, End Node sends the closing with the applicant name, normalized phone, email, and an applicant-facing reference. A UUID-shaped reference is correct and is not internal diagnostic output. The closing does not claim a policy was issued. No reply exposes an error code, HTTP status, the word API, a tool name, a price, or a policy-issued claim.
